reviews.name: serialize-javascript
reviews.reason: Established Yahoo package already used by Mocha. The reviewed update fixes GHSA-m5mm-p8h7-m29v. Maintainers, registry source and BSD-3-Clause license are unchanged; the four-file tarball has no install hooks or new dependencies. Registry signatures and provenance attestations verify. Full npm and production audits report no vulnerabilities. The lock delta changes one development dependency only; no extension runtime dependency changes.

reviews.name: @isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match
reviews.reason: New matcher component maintained by the existing minimatch maintainer, isaacs. Its complete TypeScript and generated CommonJS were reviewed: no network, filesystem, subprocess or dynamic-code execution. Polynomial matching paths and capped caches improve trusted development-pattern handling; this is not approval for arbitrary hostile patterns or a universal resource bound. Registry signatures and exact tarball integrity verify. BlueOak-1.0.0 license, contents, complete lock delta and lifecycle scripts reviewed; no new install hooks. Provenance evidence is a verified signed upstream tag and packaged/source-map source correspondence with direct generated-code inspection, not an npm SLSA attestation (none is published). No extension runtime dependency changes.
